QuestInfo.name: Back to Elf School 1
QuestInfo.0: Aside from losing all your levels, you seem to be okay. The only way for you to get your old strength is to train like crazy. Unfair!
QuestInfo.1: This is no time to feel sorry for yourself. You need to get out of Elluel and make sure Maple World is okay. But first, you need to #btrain#k, just like when you were little... #o9300423##r #a240421##k
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated #o9300423# and gained some experience. Still...what would your subjects think if they saw you like this?

0.0: All right, it's obvious what I have to do. I need to get out into Maple World and make sure the Black Mage is still sealed away. But...I'm still too weak to make it past the slimes...
0.1: Do I have to start my training from all over again? I can't even remember what I used to do to train! Hm... I was still a kid, so I couldn't leave town... I think I had to fight #o9300423# in #bElf School#k.
0.2: Back to Elf School with me, then? A fine picture this makes, the sovereign of the Elves, master of the Dual Bowguns, struggling to take down training dummies... Hm. Wait, didn't I also used to train by fighting #rYetis and Wyverns#k...? I guess they'd eat me in one bite if they saw me now...
0.3: Okay, Elf School is my only option. Otherwise, I won't stand a chance against the powerful slimes outside...

yes.0: Come on, Mercedes. Nobody is watching. I can do this!

no.0: No, there's got to be another way! Another option... No... There are no other options!

1.0: That's 10 #o9300423# down. It's not much, but I feel a little stronger now. That's a start, at least.

default.0: Okay, time to swallow my pride and just go back to #bElf School#k. It's fine. There's nobody watching me.
